newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar off lows vs yen, but remains vulnerable.
newsitem.headline: Dollar off lows vs yen, but remains vulnerable.

text.p: 0452 GMT --*Dollar off earlier lows due to light short-covering by interbank traders in afternoon Tokyo, but still vulnerable. *Declines in Tokyo stocks, partial recovery in yen bond prices and vague rumours that some Japanese insurers in trouble lent support to dollar. *Clear break of 122.50 yen may send dollar down to 121.80 yen.
